sections.content: A discussion about digital life can combine present habits, recent changes, comparisons and hypothetical situations. Use clear connectors such as por una *parte*, por *otra* parte, *sin* *embargo* and en el futuro to organise an opinion.

items.spanish: Por una parte, la tecnología nos permite comunicarnos rápidamente.
items.english: On the one hand, technology allows us to communicate quickly.

items.spanish: Por otra parte, también ha cambiado nuestra relación con la privacidad.
items.english: On the other hand, it has also changed our relationship with privacy.

items.spanish: Sin embargo, creo que podemos buscar un equilibrio.
items.english: However, I think we can look for a balance.

items.spanish: Si utilizáramos menos las pantallas, quizá tendríamos más tiempo para hablar cara a cara.
items.english: If we used screens less, perhaps we would have more time to talk face to face.

sections.content: Integrated discussion should distinguish present habits, past changes, comparisons and hypothetical consequences.
